title: Dynamic route params: In Next.js 16, dynamic page params are asynchronous and should be awaited before validating, decoding or using a slug
description: Next.js 16 and TypeScript 5 App Router lesson for dynamic route params. Includes an intentionally broken starter, a corrected contract, verified-path offline tests and official documentation.
objectives: In Next.js 16, dynamic page params are asynchronous and should be awaited before validating, decoding or using a slug.
Repair the intentionally failing next-async-dynamic-params model.
Explain which behaviors need real Next.js compilation or browser integration verification.
rubric: I can explain dynamic route params in Next.js 16 without mixing older Pages Router semantics.
I can reproduce and fix the 07.01.03 failing starter with real data inputs.
I can identify the missing Next.js build, routing and HTTP integration evidence.
